region.description: The [Region id](#operation/list-regions) to create the instance.

plan.description: The [Bare Metal plan id](#operation/list-metal-plans) to use for this instance.

script_id.description: The [Startup Script id](#operation/list-startup-scripts) to use for this instance.

sshkey_id.description: The [SSH Key id](#operation/list-ssh-keys) to install on this instance.

user_data.description: The user-supplied, base64 encoded [user data](https://www.vultr.com/docs/manage-instance-user-data-with-the-vultr-metadata-api/) for this Instance.

activation_email.description:
Notify by email after deployment.

* true
* false (default)

hostname.description: The user-supplied hostname to use when deploying this instance.

reserved_ipv4.description: The [Reserved IP id](#operation/list-reserved-ips) for this instance.

os_id.description: If supplied, deploy the instance using this [Operating System id](#operation/list-os).

snapshot_id.description: If supplied, deploy the instance using this [Snapshot ID](#operation/list-snapshots).

app_id.description: If supplied, deploy the instance using this [Application id](#operation/list-applications).

image_id.description: If supplied, deploy the instance using this [Application image_id](#operation/list-applications).

attach_vpc2.description: An array of [VPC IDs](#operation/list-vpc2) to attach to this Bare Metal Instance. This parameter takes precedence over `enable_vpc2`. Please choose one parameter.

detach_vpc2.description: An array of [VPC IDs](#operation/list-vpc2) to detach from this Bare Metal Instance. This parameter takes precedence over `enable_vpc2`.

enable_vpc2.description:
If `true`, VPC 2.0 support will be added to the new server.

This parameter attaches a single VPC 2.0 netowrk. When no VPC 2.0 network exists in the region, it will be automatically created.

If there are multiple VPC 2.0 networks in the instance's region, use `attach_vpc2` instead to specify a VPC 2.0 network.

tags.description: Tags to apply to the instance.

user_scheme.description:
Linux-only: The user scheme used for logging into this instance. By default, the "root" user is configured. Alternatively, a limited user with sudo permissions can be selected.

* root
* limited
